_notes: 'Arcana' in relic descriptions means Mult (UI wording to be unified).
mult relics: multFormulaJS receives c = {L: cast letters (wildcards resolved), sp: array of each tile's Spell Power} and returns the Mult bonus.
Mult relics do NOT apply to single-tile casts (fallback).
starter and boss relics never appear in shops, chests, elite rewards or events; boss relics are offered (pick 1 of 3) after each Act 1-3 boss.

relics.name: Twin Moons
relics.description: +0.5 Arcana if word length is even.

relics.name: Odd Fang
relics.description: +0.5 Arcana if word length is odd.

relics.name: Ouroboros Loop
relics.description: +1.5 Arcana if first letter matches last letter.

relics.name: Vowel Prism
relics.description: +0.25 Arcana per unique vowel.

relics.name: Consonant Coil
relics.description: +0.2 Arcana per unique consonant.

relics.name: Mirror Shard
relics.description: +1 Arcana per pair of adjacent identical letters.

relics.name: Lone Wolf Seal
relics.description: +0.5 Arcana if no letter repeats.

relics.name: Triad Totem
relics.description: +2.5 Arcana if one letter appears 3+ times.
relics.multFormulaJS: c=>{const m={};for(const ch of c.L)m[ch]=(m[ch]||0)+1;return Object.values(m).some(v=>v>=3)?2.5:0}

relics.name: Heavy Ink
relics.description: +0.4 Arcana per played tile with Spell Power ≥ 5.

relics.name: Pebble Charm
relics.description: +1 Arcana if ALL played tiles have Spell Power ≤ 4.

relics.name: Long Scroll
relics.description: +2 Arcana if word is 7+ letters.

relics.name: Ledger Stone
relics.description: +0.75 Arcana if total base Spell Power ≥ 15.

relics.name: Heart Vowel
relics.description: +0.75 Arcana if the exact middle letter is a vowel.

relics.name: Dawn Glyph
relics.description: +0.5 Arcana if word starts with A–F.

relics.name: Dusk Glyph
relics.description: +0.5 Arcana if word ends with T–Z.

relics.name: Open Mouth
relics.description: +1.5 Arcana if word starts and ends with vowels.

relics.name: Choir Bell
relics.description: +1.5 Arcana if vowels outnumber consonants.
